cwe_content.cwe: CWE-668,Exposure of Resource to Wrong Sphere

candidate.Reason: On Java 6 and lower, creates temporary files with insecure permissions (world-readable by default) in the system temporary directory, which can be shared between users on Unix-like systems and older Windows/Mac OSX versions, allowing local information disclosure of uploaded files stored in temp directory

cwe_content.cwe: CWE-379,Creation of Temporary File in Directory with Insecure Permissions

candidate.Reason: On Java 6 and lower, creates temporary files using File.createTempFile() which uses system temporary directory with potentially insecure permissions, allowing local information disclosure via shared temporary directory on Unix-like systems and older Windows/Mac OSX versions

cwe_content.cwe: CWE-378,Creation of Temporary File With Insecure Permissions
